13.1.en: Arjuna wants to understand the basics: the body, the soul, and how knowing really works.
13.1.hi: Arjun basics samajhna chahta hai: body, aatma, aur gyaan asli mein kaise kaam karta hai.

13.2.en: Krishna: "Your body is the field. The one who knows the body is the knower of the field."
13.2.hi: Krishna: "Tumhara body khet hai. Jo body ko jaanta hai, woh khet ka jaankaar hai."

13.3.en: "I'm the knower in every body. Understanding the body and the knower is real knowledge."
13.3.hi: "Har body mein jaanne wala main hoon. Body aur jaanne wale ko samajhna hi asli gyaan hai."

13.4.en: "Let me quickly explain what the body is, how it changes, and who the self is."
13.4.hi: "Chalo jaldi samjhata hoon ki body kya hai, kaise badalti hai, aur self kaun hai."

13.5.en: Sages have explained this in many ways, through hymns and solid logic.
13.5.hi: Rishiyon ne ye kai tareekon se samjhaya hai, bhajanon aur pakke tark se.

13.6.en: The elements, ego, intellect, the senses and what they experience. That's the field.
13.6.hi: Tatva, ego, buddhi, senses aur jo woh experience karte hain. Yahi khet hai.

13.7.en: Desire, hate, pleasure, pain and awareness are all part of the field, too.
13.7.hi: Chahat, nafrat, sukh, dukh aur chetna, ye sab bhi khet ka hissa hain.

13.8.en: Real wisdom looks like humility, no showing off, non-violence, patience, honesty and respect for teachers.
13.8.hi: Asli gyaan aisa dikhta hai: vinamrata, dikhawa nahi, ahimsa, sabr, imaandaari aur guru ki izzat.

13.9.en: Not chasing sense pleasures, no ego, and seeing clearly that birth, ageing and illness bring pain.
13.9.hi: Sense ke mazon ke peeche na bhaagna, ego nahi, aur saaf dekhna ki janam, budhapa aur bimaari dukh laate hain.

13.10.en: Not clinging to people and stuff, and staying balanced whether things go your way or not.
13.10.hi: Logon aur cheezon se na chipakna, aur cheezein apne hisaab se hon ya na hon, balance rakhna.

13.11.en: Steady devotion, enjoying solitude, and not needing the crowd's approval.
13.11.hi: Pakki bhakti, akelapan enjoy karna, aur bheed ki approval na chahiye hona.

13.12.en: Keep reflecting on who you really are and searching for truth. That's wisdom. The rest is ignorance.
13.12.hi: Lagataar socho tum asli mein kaun ho aur sach dhoondo. Yahi gyaan hai. Baaki agyaan hai.

13.13.en: Now, what's worth knowing: the eternal truth. Know it and you become immortal.
13.13.hi: Ab, jo jaanne layak hai: shaashvat sach. Ise jaano toh amar ho jaate ho.

13.14.en: It has hands, feet, eyes and ears everywhere. It covers everything.
13.14.hi: Iske haath, pair, aankhein aur kaan har jagah hain. Ye sab ko dhake hai.

13.15.en: It powers the senses without having senses. It supports all but clings to nothing.
13.15.hi: Ye senses ko chalata hai bina khud senses ke. Sabko sambhalta hai par kisi se chipakta nahi.

13.16.en: It's inside and outside everything, still yet moving, far away yet really close.
13.16.hi: Ye har cheez ke andar aur bahar hai, ruka hua par chalta, door par bilkul paas.

13.17.en: It's one, but seems divided among beings. It creates, sustains and absorbs everything.
13.17.hi: Ye ek hai, par jeevon mein bata hua lagta hai. Ye sab banata, sambhalta aur samet leta hai.

13.18.en: It's the light behind all lights, beyond darkness, and it lives in every heart.
13.18.hi: Ye har roshni ke peeche ki roshni hai, andhere se pare, aur har dil mein rehti hai.

13.19.en: That's the field, wisdom and the truth, in short. Understand it and you're ready for me.
13.19.hi: Short mein yahi khet, gyaan aur sach hai. Ise samjho toh tum mere liye ready ho.

13.20.en: Nature and the soul both have no beginning. All changes and qualities come from nature.
13.20.hi: Prakriti aur aatma dono anaadi hain. Saare badlaav aur gun prakriti se aate hain.

13.21.en: Nature does the doing. The soul is what experiences pleasure and pain.
13.21.hi: Karne ka kaam prakriti karti hai. Sukh-dukh ka anubhav aatma karti hai.

13.22.en: The soul gets attached to nature's qualities, and that attachment decides the next birth.
13.22.hi: Aatma prakriti ke gunon se jud jaati hai, aur yahi attachment agla janam tay karta hai.

13.23.en: The soul in you is the witness, the supporter, the experiencer, the supreme self.
13.23.hi: Tumhare andar ki aatma saakshi, sahara, anubhav karne wali, param aatma hai.

13.24.en: Understand the soul and nature properly, and you won't be reborn, whatever your situation.
13.24.hi: Aatma aur prakriti ko theek se samjho, toh dobara janam nahi hoga, chahe tumhari situation kuch bhi ho.

13.25.en: Some find the self through meditation, some through knowledge, some through selfless work.
13.25.hi: Koi self ko dhyaan se paata hai, koi gyaan se, koi selfless kaam se.

13.26.en: Others just listen to the wise and follow with faith. They get there too.
13.26.hi: Kuch log bas gyaaniyon ko sunte hain aur bharose se follow karte hain. Woh bhi pahunchte hain.

13.27.en: Everything that's born, moving or still, comes from body and soul coming together.
13.27.hi: Jo bhi paida hota hai, chalta ya ruka, body aur aatma ke milne se hota hai.

13.28.en: Whoever sees the same eternal divine in every being, even as bodies die, truly sees.
13.28.hi: Jo har jeev mein ek hi amar divine dekhta hai, body marne ke baad bhi, wahi sach mein dekhta hai.

13.29.en: Seeing the divine equally everywhere, you stop hurting yourself and reach the highest.
13.29.hi: Har jagah barabar divine dekhne se tum khud ko hurt karna band karte ho aur sabse ooncha paate ho.

13.30.en: Whoever sees that nature does the acting, not the soul, truly sees.
13.30.hi: Jo dekhta hai ki karm prakriti karti hai, aatma nahi, wahi sach mein dekhta hai.

13.31.en: When you see all the variety coming from one source, you've found the ultimate.
13.31.hi: Jab saari variety ek hi source se aati dikhe, tab tumne ultimate paa liya.

13.32.en: The supreme self lives in the body but never changes, never acts and is never stained.
13.32.hi: Param aatma body mein rehti hai par kabhi badalti nahi, karti nahi, aur daag nahi lagta.

13.33.en: Like space is everywhere but nothing sticks to it, the soul isn't stained by the body.
13.33.hi: Jaise aakash har jagah hai par us pe kuch chipakta nahi, waise aatma body se maili nahi hoti.

13.34.en: Like one sun lights up the whole world, the soul lights up the whole body.
13.34.hi: Jaise ek suraj poori duniya ko roshan karta hai, waise aatma poore body ko.

13.35.en: See the difference between body and soul clearly, and how to break free, and you reach the supreme.
13.35.hi: Body aur aatma ka farak saaf dekho, aur free hone ka tareeka, toh param tak pahunchoge.
